player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Okutambula kulina okubeera mu kika kya [macro micro] nga kuliko ennamba 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Buli index erina kuba wakati wa 0 ne 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: The micro_board, row, or col is out of range.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Omuzannyo gw'alina okuzannyira ku kipande ekiddako.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: The micro board is already won.

game_action.played: Omuzannyi {player_id} azannya mu kibanda kino {macro_idx}, saiti {micro_idx} (safu {row}, koziri {col}). Omuzannyi {opponent_id} kye yakula kukwata ku {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Omuzannyi {player_id} awangula Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
